body: Wave 3 shipped as #222 (keyboard-focus, draft, MERGEABLE, +3642 -1151 in 60 files): 5 Lanes ok, gate 15 pass, 0 inert, 0 inconclusive; reconcile only lists today_capture_buttons.dart as unwritten (its StickerButtons were rebuilt by design-controls-focusable, checked by shell). Branch at 9523b6f: flutter analyze clean, full suite 3409 pass. No existing test or baseline edited by any Lane.U+000ABehaviours for the owner: (1) on macOS Flutter's highlight mode treats a mouse click as keyboard, so a dialog opened by a click shows the ring on its safe button, and clicking into the viewer's note text shows its ring; phone taps show none. This matches the spec rule as written (ring follows Flutter's highlight mode). (2) Beyond the briefs: FocusRing takes an optional borderRadius; the toast joins the focus scope of the screen that showed it so Tab reaches Undo; the table toolbar got a widget-order traversal group (Shift+Tab looped in c8 without it); the photo caption FocusScope was removed and the field requests focus itself; Discard/Save on the video recorder also use the dark ring. (3) Known leftovers: Tab forward into an already right-scrolled table toolbar does not scroll its left controls into view; after a month change focus lands on Next month; Add memory reads before the editor.
